# awscc_networksecuritymanager_scope (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::NetworkSecurityManager::Scope. Creates and manages a Network Security Manager scope.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope_name` (String) The name of the scope.

### Optional

- `scope_configuration` (String) The scope configuration as a JSON string.
- `scope_description` (String) A description of the scope.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags associated with the scope. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `scope_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the scope.
- `scope_id` (String) The unique identifier of the scope.
- `status` (String) The status of the scope.
- `version` (String) The version number of the scope.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_networksecuritymanager_scope.example
  identity = {
    scope_arn = "scope_arn"
  }
}
```
